title: Boundedness of the open projection source
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring, j : U → X an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], L an etale sheaf of Λ-modules on U whose canonical coefficient realization [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] is finite locally free of rank t ≥ 0. For any integer m and any bounded-below derived etale sheaf G on X [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], put F = L[0][m]. Then the open projection source j! (F tensor^L Lj* G), with the canonical derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] and exact derived extension by zero, is bounded below. No flatness or Tor-amplitude assumption is made on G.

source.place: the corresponding proof step of lem-pur-open-projection-site-transport

proof.text: The flatness bridge makes L flat, so its single complex has Tor amplitude [0,0]. Exact pullback takes G to a bounded-below derived object. isGE_tensor_of_torAmplitudeIn bounds its tensor with the single complex. The shift changes the bound by -m; the tensor shift isomorphism transports that bound. Exact open extension preserves this lower bound by isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj.
